svg.title: History-grounded Reflect and Verify
svg.desc: The original image puts a cup on the couch. The first reflection raises the cup onto a shelf, but verification cannot detect the couch. The second reflection preserves the shelf and makes the couch explicit. The final image passes verification against the original request. Each revision is generated by the same frozen generator.

g.text: “a photo of a couch below a cup”
Raise the cup onto a shelf;
The MLLM reflector uses the original request, previous images, and verifier feedback.
